tasks.title: Product Vision, Principles & 8-Domain Capability Mapping
tasks.description: Create PRODUCT.md, PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES.md, PRODUCT_PRINCIPLES.md, and ROADMAP.md establishing the Places, People, Experiences loop and 8 capability domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Product vision and 6 core product principles documented.
Full 8-domain capability map established across Capability Complete, Product Integrated, and Platform Ready tiers.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Foundational specification artifact; prevents disposable MVP-only architectural shortcuts.

tasks.title: Frontend Architecture Evaluation & ADR 003 Ratification
tasks.description: Evaluate Flutter + Riverpod vs. React + mobile wrapper across 11 technical dimensions and record the decision in docs/adr/003-frontend-stack-decision.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Both candidates evaluated against native experience, maps, camera, navigation, state management, testing, and maintenance.
Flutter (lib/) ratified as the sole canonical mobile application.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Eliminates parallel frontend divergence while preserving src/ strictly as a read-only visual reference.

tasks.title: 8-Domain Entity-Relationship & Data Contract Architecture
tasks.description: Define relationships across Users, Profiles, Friendships, Places, Drops, Media, Collections, Plans, Stories, Notifications, Reports, and Blocks in ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Mermaid ER diagram and 8-domain module boundaries documented in ARCHITECTURE.md.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Establishes single source of truth for domain contracts.

tasks.title: Repository Consolidation & Build Artifact Purge
tasks.description: Remove committed node_modules/ (3,077 files, ~97 MB), align README/ADRs/CI, and standardize source organization.
acceptanceCriteria: No committed node_modules or build output in repository archive.
README, ADRs, and CI accurately reflect the canonical architecture.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Reduces repository archive size by >90% and prevents platform-locked binary failures.

tasks.title: Critical Database Security Remediation (SEC-01 & SEC-02)
tasks.description: Remediate get_friends_feed spoofing (SEC-01) and friendship self-acceptance (SEC-02) in baseline and corrective migrations, and add SQL authorization tests.
acceptanceCriteria: get_friends_feed is SECURITY INVOKER and derives caller strictly from auth.uid().
friendships_update_recipient_only policy and enforce_friendship_transition trigger prevent self-acceptance.
Negative authorization tests in rls_authorization_test.sql verify all 8 invariants.
tasks.riskAssessment: Critical blocker resolved: Prevents unauthorized access to friends-only content.

tasks.title: Application Stabilization & Canonical Tashkent Seed Alignment
tasks.description: Unify all venue and profile IDs on Tashkent, repair Story Rail and Friends Feed seeds, fix .whereType<PlaceModel>(), and remove deprecated_member_use suppression.
acceptanceCriteria: Friends Feed renders valid Tashkent drops on launch.
Every Story Rail item resolves to a valid Tashkent venue.
Saved screen uses .whereType<PlaceModel>() and functional status filters.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: All legacy aliases map cleanly via resolveCanonicalId.

tasks.title: Native Mobile Foundation & Toolchain Constraints
tasks.description: Configure iOS Info.plist & PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, Android camera/location/internet permissions, and fix pubspec.yaml SDK constraint to ^3.5.0.
acceptanceCriteria: iOS and Android permission declarations and privacy manifests are complete.
Dart SDK constraint ^3.5.0 resolves cleanly.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Prevents runtime permission crashes on iOS 17+ and Android 13/14.

tasks.title: Backend Infrastructure, Environment Config & Observability
tasks.description: Configure supabase/config.toml, .env.example, compile-time --dart-define initialization with service_role guard, and structured AppLogger telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: Credentials injected via build-time --dart-define variables.
service_role keys are rejected if accidentally passed.
All repository errors are logged through AppLogger.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Graceful local fallback preserved when running offline tests.

tasks.title: Identity Lifecycle, Authentication & Profile Triggers
tasks.description: Implement /auth Sign Up & Sign In screen, session persistence, sign-out, automatic on_auth_user_created profile creation trigger, and profile editing.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can register, sign in, edit their profile, and sign out.
handle_new_user() trigger provisions public.profiles automatically.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Username format and uniqueness constraints enforced in SQL and Dart.

tasks.title: Media Storage Infrastructure & Upload Lifecycle
tasks.description: Provision post-media Storage bucket with 5MB & MIME RLS policies, client validation, persistent base64/Storage upload, and orphan media cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP images <= 5 MB are accepted.
Picked photos survive OS temp cache purges and clean up orphans on DB error.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Dual-layer Storage RLS prevents unauthorized media reads.

tasks.title: Places Domain: Geospatial Discovery, Search & Tashkent Map
tasks.description: Implement PostGIS get_nearby_places with search_query and category filters, FlutterMap rendering, Haversine distances, custom venue creation, and external directions.
acceptanceCriteria: Search and category chips filter Tashkent venues across Map and List modes.
Haversine distance calculation and denied-permission fallback work cleanly.
tasks.riskAssessment: Medium: Production deployment should inject a commercial MAP_TILE_URL key via --dart-define.

tasks.title: Social Graph Domain: Mutual Friendship State Machine & User Profiles
tasks.description: Implement FriendshipStatusesNotifier (none, pendingOutgoing, pendingIncoming, accepted), incoming request accept/decline UI, and /users/:id profile navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: System distinguishes pendingOutgoing, pendingIncoming, and accepted friendships.
Tapping any user avatar navigates to /users/:id.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Backed by recipient-only RLS policy in 00002/00005.

tasks.title: Experiences Domain: Drop Creation, Editing, Deletion & Rating Sync
tasks.description: Implement 4-step Drop creation, publishDrop, editDrop, deleteDrop, and automatic venue rating recalculation trigger (recalculate_place_rating).
acceptanceCriteria: Users can publish, edit, and delete their own Drops.
Publishing or deleting a rated public Drop recalculates places.avg_rating.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Ownership verified via author_id = auth.uid().

tasks.title: Discovery Domain: Dual-Layer Feeds & Place Detail Partitioning
tasks.description: Implement finite Friends Feed (syncRemoteFeed -> get_friends_feed), Public Discovery, and partitioned Friends vs. Public tabs on Place Detail screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Friends Feed only displays drops from accepted friends and self.
Place Detail tabs strictly separate Friends Drops from Public Reviews.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Verified by unit and SQL authorization tests.

tasks.title: Collections Domain: Saved Places (Want to go / Been) & Custom Lists
tasks.description: Implement SavedPlaceStatusesNotifier (want_to_go, been), segmented filtering on SavedScreen, and public.collections + collection_items schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Want to go and Been filters work and persist across sessions.
Custom and collaborative collections schema and RLS policies active in 00006.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Synced with public.saved_places and trg_saved_places_count.

tasks.title: Social Ecosystem: Friend Plans, 24h Stories, Reactions, Comments & Notifications
tasks.description: Implement FriendPlansNotifier, NotificationsScreen, and database schemas/RLS for friend_plan_participants (RSVP), place_stories (24h expiration), post_reactions, and post_comments.
acceptanceCriteria: Friend plans, notifications, stories, reactions, and comments persist in PostgreSQL and honor dual-layer RLS and blocking.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: All engagement tables enforce NOT is_blocked() and audience visibility.

tasks.title: Trust & Safety Operations: Blocking, 3-Report Quarantine, Audit Logs & GDPR Lifecycle
tasks.description: Implement user blocking, content reporting, 3-report auto-quarantine trigger, moderation_audit_logs table, GDPR JSON export, and server-side delete_own_account() RPC.
acceptanceCriteria: 3 reports automatically quarantine a Drop and record an entry in moderation_audit_logs.
GDPR export and delete_own_account() RPC work without a client service_role key.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Full audit trail maintained in public.moderation_audit_logs.

tasks.title: Intelligent Discovery: Explainable Privacy-Preserving Recommendations
tasks.description: Implement get_recommended_places() PostGIS/SQL RPC and PlacesRepository.getRecommendedPlaces scoring venues by accepted friends' drops, saved category affinity, and rating.
acceptanceCriteria: Every recommendation includes a human-readable explanation and numeric relevanceScore.
Private visits from non-friends are never used as global ranking signals.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Explainable deterministic scoring avoids opaque ML cold-start issues.

tasks.title: Platform Maturity, Automated Regression Suites & CI/CD Release Gates
tasks.description: Maintain unit, widget, and SQL RLS regression tests, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, rate-limiting triggers, and RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md / SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md.
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 domains verified at Product Integrated / Platform Ready maturity.
CI/CD and SQL security test suites pass with zero open Critical/High issues.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Continuous regression gates active on every pull request.

tasks.title: Cursor-Based Keyset Pagination for Feeds & Geospatial Discovery
tasks.description: Upgrade get_friends_feed and get_nearby_places in a new migration (00010_cursor_pagination.sql) and wire cursor pagination (before_created_at, before_id) into PostsRepository and PlacesRepository.
acceptanceCriteria: get_friends_feed accepts optional p_cursor_created_at and p_cursor_id parameters for O(1) keyset pagination.
PostsRepository.loadMoreFriendsFeed fetches the next page without duplicate drops.
Unit and SQL tests verify deterministic ordering and pagination boundaries.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Backwards-compatible default NULL cursor parameters preserve existing callers.

tasks.title: EXIF GPS Metadata Stripping & Client Image Compression Pipeline
tasks.description: Strip raw EXIF GPS/camera metadata and re-encode picked images to WebP/JPEG <= 1920px before uploading to the post-media bucket in SupabaseService.uploadPostMedia.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploaded image bytes have EXIF GPS tags stripped prior to Supabase Storage transmission.
Images exceeding 5 MB after compression are rejected with a clear user-facing error.
Unit tests verify EXIF sanitization and MIME/size guards.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Protects user home/device location privacy on public and friends-only drops.

tasks.title: Custom & Collaborative Collections UI Wiring (Migration 00006 Integration)
tasks.description: Connect the existing public.collections and public.collection_items tables from 00006_platform_domains_and_discovery.sql to SavedPlacesRepository and SavedScreen so users can create custom themed lists and add places.
acceptanceCriteria: SavedPlacesRepository syncs custom collections and collection_items with Supabase when configured.
SavedScreen renders a Collections tab alongside Want to go and Been with a Create Collection modal.
Widget and unit tests verify creating a collection and adding/removing a Tashkent venue.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Database schema and RLS policies for collections are already deployed in 00006.

tasks.title: Interactive Drop Reactions, Comments & Plan RSVP UI Wiring
tasks.description: Wire public.post_reactions, public.post_comments, and public.friend_plan_participants from Migration 00006 into PostsRepository, SavedPlacesRepository, FeedScreen, and PlaceDetailScreen.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can toggle reactions (heart/fire/bookmark) and post comments on visible Drops.
Friends can RSVP (going/interested) to Friend Plans on SavedScreen.
All interactions persist via Supabase and update optimistic Riverpod state with rollback on failure.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Backing tables and RLS triggers already exist in 00006_platform_domains_and_discovery.sql.

tasks.title: Automated Staging Ship Gate, RLS Verification & Release Tagging
tasks.description: Execute the staging-shipper skill to validate migrations 00001-00007, run supabase/tests/rls_authorization_test.sql, build the release bundle, and push the staging release tag.
acceptanceCriteria: flutter analyze, flutter test, and npm test pass with zero warnings or failures.
All 14 RLS security invariants pass in supabase/tests/rls_authorization_test.sql.
Release build completes and PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES.md marks all 8 domains Platform Ready.
verificationCommands: flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings && flutter test && npm run lint && npm test
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Final automated release gate before production cutover.

tasks.title: Real-Time Live Drops & Reactions Broadcast via Supabase Channels
tasks.description: Connect SupabaseClient.channel('public:posts') in PostsRepository to listen for INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE events, streaming new friend drops and real-time reaction counters directly to FeedScreen without manual pull-to-refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: PostsRepository manages a real-time postgres changes subscription on public.posts and public.post_reactions.
New posts from followed friends are prepended smoothly without layout jumps.
Hermetic unit tests verify subscription lifecycle, stream parsing, and offline fallback.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Non-breaking additive real-time enhancement backed by existing Supabase publication.

tasks.title: 24-Hour Ephemeral Venue Stories Capture & Fullscreen Player
tasks.description: Wire public.place_stories from Migration 00006 into StoriesRepository, StoryRail, and a fullscreen gesture-driven StoryViewerScreen with progress bars, countdown timer, and camera capture.
acceptanceCriteria: Stories display with active 24-hour expiration countdown and only visible to authorized audience (friends/public).
Fullscreen story viewer supports tap-to-advance and pause-on-hold.
Automated tests verify story retrieval, filtering, and expiry.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Ephemeral stories schema and RLS policies are already deployed in 00006.

tasks.title: Biometric App Lock & In-Memory Sensitive Visit History Vault
tasks.description: Implement an optional biometric/PIN app lock using local_auth when app transitions to background, and secure user visit history memory cache when hide_visits_history is enabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can toggle 'Require Biometrics on Resume' in Settings.
App blurs preview and prompts for authentication if backgrounded for >60 seconds.
Unit tests verify privacy flag enforcement and settings persistence.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Local hardware capability with graceful fallback when biometric hardware is unconfigured.

tasks.title: Deep Linking & Universal Routing for Venues & Drops
tasks.description: Configure deep link URI parsing for places and drops (around://places/:id, around://drops/:id) in go_router and add native share action sheet helpers to copy canonical links.
acceptanceCriteria: Deep link URIs with custom scheme or web domain route to matching PlaceDetailScreen or drop viewer.
Share button in PlaceDetail copies canonical link to system clipboard with user toast.
Unit tests verify slug resolution and deep link URI mapping.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Extends existing go_router declarative routes without breaking state.

tasks.title: Offline Outbox Auto-Sync & Exponential Retry Engine
tasks.description: Harden OutboxService with background network change listeners, exponential backoff, maximum retry capping, and idempotent UUID dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed drop actions enqueue in persistent outbox with unique idempotency keys.
Network reconnect triggers drainOutbox() with exponential backoff on transient errors.
Unit tests verify outbox retry bounds and idempotency.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Outbox operates alongside existing repository providers.

tasks.title: Staging Release v1.1.0 Verification & Release Tagging
tasks.description: Execute comprehensive multi-suite verification across Flutter and React, generate release documentation, and ship release tag v1.1.0-staging.1.
acceptanceCriteria: All unit, widget, and lint tests pass with zero warnings.
Release notes for v1.1.0 recorded in ROADMAP.md and COMPANY_PULSE.md.
Git release tag created and pushed to origin.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Verification and staging release gating.

tasks.title: Shareable Tashkent Taste Passport & Profile Card
tasks.description: Build an editorial, high-aesthetic shareable Taste Passport widget showcasing a user's curated top venues, district badges, and bio, with copyable link and deep link routing.
acceptanceCriteria: TastePassportCard renders top recommended Tashkent venues, district badges, and user stats.
Deep link handler around://passport/:username opens user's taste passport.
ProfileScreen provides interactive 'Share Taste Passport' action with link copying.
Unit and widget tests verify passport rendering and data binding.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: High viral discovery value; leverages existing place and profile repositories.

tasks.title: Mutual Friend Invite Links & QR Connection Engine
tasks.description: Implement FriendInviteService generating signed invite URLs and QR payload strings, with automatic mutual friend connection intent resolution on deep link navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: FriendInviteService generates deterministic invite links around://invite/:code.
Opening invite link initiates mutual friend request without requiring manual search.
ProfileScreen displays quick invite action.
Unit tests verify invite generation and acceptance validation.
tasks.riskAssessment: Medium: Mutual friendship security invariant must be preserved.

tasks.title: Contextual Time-of-Day Atmosphere Engine & Real-Time Filter
tasks.description: Create AtmosphereService that dynamically classifies Tashkent local time into urban rhythms (Morning Brew, Afternoon Focus, Golden Hour, Late Night Vinyl) and filters Explore venues accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: AtmosphereService returns accurate time-of-day mode and recommended vibes.
ExploreScreen displays dynamic atmosphere banner and contextual chips.
Unit tests verify time boundaries and venue matching.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Enhances place relevance without schema migrations.

tasks.title: Trilingual Tashkent Localization Engine (UZ / RU / EN)
tasks.description: Implement persistent in-app localization engine supporting Uzbek, Russian, and English with dynamic locale switcher in Settings.
acceptanceCriteria: LocaleService persists language preference across app restarts.
Provides translated strings for Uzbek, Russian, and English.
SettingsScreen allows one-tap language switching with instant UI update.
Unit tests verify translation lookups and persistence.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Client-side locale management; zero external dependencies.

tasks.title: Environment Configuration Architecture (AppConfig)
tasks.description: Implement 3-tier environment configuration (dev, staging, production) resolving Supabase URL, anon key, deep link domain, and timeouts via --dart-define.
acceptanceCriteria: AppConfig resolves dev, staging, or production mode cleanly from String.fromEnvironment('ENV').
Provides environment-specific Supabase credentials, deep link domain, and timeouts.
SupabaseService strictly validates credentials and rejects service_role keys in all environments.
Unit tests verify configuration resolution, fallback behavior, and key rejection security.
tasks.riskAssessment: Medium: Fundamental connection plumbing; requires robust fallbacks to avoid breaking local dev.

tasks.title: Production Analytics & Venue Telemetry Service

acceptanceCriteria: AnalyticsService instruments 12 core funnel & engagement events.
Records venue affinity telemetry (saves, drops, story views, atmosphere peaks) for future B2B portal.
Dispatches events safely without blocking UI and logs structured payloads.
Unit tests verify event payloads, sanitization, and offline handling.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Pure service abstraction; zero breaking UI changes.

tasks.title: First-Run Onboarding Redesign (Social & Privacy Focused)

acceptanceCriteria: 3-screen interactive onboarding: Discover Through Friends -> Drop & Choose Audience -> District & Friend Invite.
Persists onboarding completion in StorageService.
Emits onboarding_complete analytics event upon finish.
Widget tests verify navigation, state persistence, and responsive UI.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Screen-level update; existing router handles completed state.

tasks.title: Telegram Social Graph & Invite Loop Integration

acceptanceCriteria: TelegramShareService constructs valid tg:// and https://t.me/share/url links with custom text and deep links.
FriendInviteScreen includes one-tap 'Share to Telegram' action alongside QR code.
Unit tests verify URI formatting, character escaping, and link parameters.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Uses platform URL launcher; zero breaking changes.

tasks.title: Actionable Empty States & Error Resilience UX

acceptanceCriteria: EmptyStateWidget supports title, subtitle, icon, and primary/secondary CTAs.
FeedScreen shows social invite CTA when user has no friend drops.
SavedScreen shows explore CTA when user has no saved places.
Widget tests verify rendering and button callbacks.
tasks.riskAssessment: Low: Visual polish and UX resilience.

acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds composite indexes with IF NOT EXISTS.
